description.fun: A newborn Ponyta can barely stand, so it builds up its legs by chasing its parents and jumping over grass that grows taller every day. It pays off: its hooves are said to be ten times harder than diamond, and old Pokédex entries claim it can leap clean over the Eiffel Tower. Its fiery mane appears about an hour after it hatches.
description.guide: A Fire Pokémon resembling a cream-coloured foal with a mane and tail of flames. It is a powerful jumper with very hard hooves, and lives in herds on plains and mountains. It evolves into Rapidash, and its Galarian form is a Psychic type resembling a unicorn.
description.tagline: A fire foal with diamond-hard hooves and a huge jump

description.fun: Generations in Galar's forests, soaking up their life energy, turned Ponyta into a pastel pony with a fluffy mane and a little horn that can heal small wounds with a few rubs. It can read a person's heart by looking into their eyes, and hides if it finds any evil there.

Rapidash runs at about 240 km/h, reaches top speed in just ten steps and, at full gallop, barely touches the ground. It chases anything that moves just to race it, and the faster it goes, the longer its flaming mane grows. In Hisui it could cross the whole region in a day and a half. Its Japanese name is simply Gallop.
description.guide: The evolution of Ponyta, a horse-like Fire Pokémon with a single horn and a long, flaming mane. It is extremely fast and loves to race. Its Galarian form is a Psychic and Fairy type resembling a unicorn.
description.tagline: A blazing racehorse that challenges anything that moves

names.ja: ガラル ギャロップ

description.fun: Galar's Rapidash is a brave, proud unicorn with a pastel mane and a long, spiralling horn that channels a Psycho Cut strong enough to pierce sheet metal. Psychic energy stored in the fur around its hooves gives it a light, airy gait.
